rule: the remotely managed tunnel token is admitted only to its fixed protected laptop path; the provider binding names only bare-cedar-fog.561.group to http://localhost:19748 with fail-closed fallback; localhost is the bare-cedar-fog laptop's namespace, never a Cloudflare edge or cold-red-gate; the service executes cloudflared on bare-cedar-fog.
supersededInterface: account-wide cert.pem plus local tunnel JSON/config is retired; its displaced template is preserved by SHA-256 in the remote-management rectification record
cutover: cold-red-gate remains rollback only until Cloudflare delegation is active and the hostname witnesses the laptop tunnel; retire it only under a later verified act.
